kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتنحنح (form IIq)
# أَتَنَحْنَحُ (ʔatanaḥnaḥu) /ʔa.ta.naħ.na.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
# أَتَنَحْنَحَ (ʔatanaḥnaḥa) /ʔa.ta.naħ.na.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
# أَتَنَحْنَحْ (ʔatanaḥnaḥ) /ʔa.ta.naħ.naħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
